title: Today's quiz
caption: What you build today: a quiz from one article, from intent to spec to page, then a skill that makes the next quiz in one go.

steps.first: Pick one article you’d like your team to learn from. No article? The Workflow names a sample source.
steps.second: Open an AI chat, ideally Gemini or Claude; ChatGPT and Copilot work too.
steps.third: Open the quiz Workflow: “Turn a source into a quiz” is already picked. Look, don’t start yet.
steps.fourth: Not working after five minutes? Come back to the room early and we sort it out.

done: An article and an open AI chat, ready for the interview.

workflow.pick: Today’s Workflow, “Turn a source into a quiz”, is already picked. Each step has its prompt to copy, for an AI chat or a coding agent; paste each result back into its box.

talking-points.description: Show one or two example quizzes on screen share. The Workflow runs in stages: Requirements (clarify the intent), Grill (interview into a spec), Execute (build, play and fix the page), Improve (turn the run into a skill and try it).
